meaning.short_meaning: Valmiki; the sage who composed the Ramayana
meaning.long_meaning: Balmiki corresponds to the Sanskrit form वाल्मीकि. Its core lexical sense is valmiki; the sage who composed the ramayana. वाल्मीकि (valmiki) is the sage credited with composing the Ramayana; the name derives from valmika (ant-hill). The source gloss 'Sage' is correct. Balmiki is the Hindi spelling.
